name: godotwright
description: Godot 4 tools for Claude: offline Godot 4.7 API, project map, headless checks, safe edits, tests, 3D models and an AAA GDScript review.
long_description: Godotwright gives Claude checked Godot 4.7 knowledge for your project: the official class reference offline (with Godot 3 names translated), a map of your scenes, scripts, signals and input actions, a static AAA review with scores, headless checks with Godot, safe edits to scenes and project settings, unit tests, play-testing with input, screenshots, and 3D models built, viewed and checked from code. Choose your Godot project folder in the settings; tools also accept a path.

project.title: Godot project
project.description: The folder with your project.godot. Tools use it when Claude does not pass a path.

godot.title: Godot 4.7 program (optional)
godot.description: Only for checks, tests, play and screenshots. Leave empty to look in the usual install folders.
